paite: Vaihawmmi toh ne ding a na tut chiang in, na ma a om amah hoihtak in ngaihtuah in.
heading: Thugen Gukna
english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

paite: Huan anhaimi na hihleh, na gawl ah temta koih ding na hi.
english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

paite: A-anlimte duh lo ke'n; an khemna a dim ahi chih thei in.
english: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

paite: Hausa ding in kigimsak ke'n; nangmah pilna a kipan tawp in.
heading: Thugen Sagihna
english: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

paite: A-omloupi tung ah na mit na koih ding maw? Hauhsaknate'n lah amau a ding in kha akibawl ngal ua, van lam zuan a leng muvanlai bang in.
english: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

paite: Misumchit neih tanghou ne ke'n, a-anlimte leng duh sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Giatna
english: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

paite: Amah akisim bang in, huchibang ahi; Ne inla dawn in, na kiang ah achi a; himahleh alungtang nang kiang ah a-om kei hi.
english: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

paite: Na an nek na lokhe ding a, na thuhoihte na mansuah ding.
english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

paite: Mihai bil ah thugen ke'n, na thute pilna lah musit ding ahi ngal a.
heading: Thugen Kuana
english: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

paite: Tang a gamgi suan ke'n; pa neiloute lou ah lut ke'n;
heading: Thugen Sawmna
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

paite: amaute tanpa lah ahat ngal a; na siatna ding in amau thu agensak ding hi.
english: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

paite: Na lungtang hilhna lam ah suk inla, na bilte theihna thute lam ah.
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-khatna
english: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

paite: Naupang lak ah bawlhoihna it ke'n. Chiang in sat lechin leng asi kei ding hi.
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-nihna
english: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

paite: Chiang in amah na sat ding a, huan Sheol a kipan akha na suaktasak ding hi.
english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

paite: Ka tapa, na lungtang apilleh, kei mahmah, ka lungtang akipak ding;
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-thumna
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

paite: ahi, ka lungtang in nuam asa ding a, na mukte'n thil dik agen chiang un.
english: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

paite: Na lungtang in mikhialte eng kei hen; himahleh nitum in TOUPA kihtakna ah om in.
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-lina
english: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.

paite: Kipahman lah a-om taktak ngal a; huchi in na lametna satkhiak ahi kei ding.
english: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

paite: Za in, ka tapa pil in, huchi in lampi ah na lungtang pi in.
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-ngana
english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

paite: Uain haite lak ah om ke'n; sa haite lak ah.
english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

paite: Zukham hat leh anhai genthei ding uh ahi ngal a; huan ihmut haina in puansia in mi atuam ding hi.
english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

paite: Nang hon suang na pa thu ngaikhia inla, ahong upat chiang in na nu musit ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-gukna
english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

paite: Thutak lei inla, zuak ke'n; ahi, pilna, hilhna leh theihsiamna.
english: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

paite: Midiktatpa nakpitak in akipak ding; huan kuapeuh tapa pil suang in amah a kipan nopsakna anei ding hi.
english: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

paite: Na nu leh na pa kipaksak inla, nang hon suangnu nuamsasak in.
english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

paite: Ka tapa, na lungtang hon pia in, ka lampite ah na mitte kipak uhen.
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-sagihna
english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

paite: Kizuak lah phaizang thukpi ahi ngal a; huan numei lamdang zaw kokhuk kochik ahi.
english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

paite: Ahi, suamhatmi bang in abuk a, huan mite lak ah lepchiahna apungsak hi.
english: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

paite: Tunggikna kua'n anei a? Lungkhamna kua'n anei a? Kinaknate kua'n anei a? Phunna kua'n anei a? Akul lou liamnate kua'n anei a? Mit sanna kua'n anei a?
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-giatna
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

paite: Uain a peng opte'n; uain lehbulh zong dia kuante in.
english: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

paite: Asan lai in uain en ke'n, nou sung a azia asuah lai in, nemtak a apaisuk lai in.
english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

paite: Atawp chiang in gulpi bang in akei a, guldekpak bang in gu in azen hi.
english: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

paite: Na mitte'n thillamdangte amu ding a, na lungtang in thil hoihloute agenkhe ding hi.
english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

paite: Ahi, tuipi lai a lum ahihkeileh longkhuam dawn a lum bang na hi ding hi.
english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

paite: Ahon sat ua, na ka sa kei; ahon vua ua, bangmah in ka vei kei. Chikchiang in ka halh dia? Zong thak nawn na veng, na chi ding.
english: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
